description: This file defines a React functional component named 'PainList' which manages and displays a list of pain entries. It includes logic for fetching pain data from an API, handling loading and error states, and allowing deletion of individual entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of pain entries from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific pain entry by ID via the API and updates the state to remove it.
